TAKE THE RISK OR LOSE THE CHANCE.

The chance doesn't wait around.

Tag a human who lives this.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #Motivation
posts.alt: Quote card: Take the risk or lose the chance.

posts.text:
HEY YOU. YES, YOU. YOU'RE BADASS AND BEAUTIFULLY HUMAN FOR SHOWING UP ANYWAY.

Still standing. Still going. That counts.

Somebody you know needs this one today.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #BeHuman
posts.alt: Quote card: Hey you. Yes, you. You're badass and beautifully human for showing up anyway.

posts.text:
DO RIGHT. DO YOUR BEST. TREAT PEOPLE HOW YOU WANT TO BE TREATED.

Old rules. Still undefeated.

Who needed this one today?

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #DoGood
posts.alt: Quote card: Do right. Do your best. Treat people how you want to be treated.

posts.text:
SOMETIMES YOUR FAITH HAS TO BE THE DOWN PAYMENT FOR YOUR FUTURE.

Believe first. The rest catches up.

Send this to your favorite human.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #Motivation
posts.alt: Quote card: Sometimes your faith has to be the down payment for your future.

posts.text:
PUSH YOURSELF TO THE EDGE OF YOUR LIMITS. THAT'S HOW THEY EXPAND.

Comfort never stretched anything.

Save this one for the hard days.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #KeepGoing
posts.alt: Quote card: Push yourself to the edge of your limits. That's how they expand.

posts.text:
SMALL ACTS, MULTIPLIED BY MILLIONS OF PEOPLE, CAN TRANSFORM THE WORLD.

Your small act counts. They add up.

Tag a human who lives this.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #BeHuman
posts.alt: Quote card: Small acts, multiplied by millions of people, can transform the world.

posts.text:

Your energy belongs to what's next.

Somebody you know needs this one today.

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #Motivation
posts.alt: Quote card: The secret of change? Stop fighting the old. Start building the new.

posts.text:
ALWAYS TRYING TO BE NORMAL? YOU'LL NEVER KNOW HOW AMAZING YOU CAN BE.

Normal was never the goal.

Who needed this one today?

#WeTheHumans #StayAwesomeHumans #BeHuman
